extra.comment: QCD dijets with pThat > 200 GeV, clustered into large-radius R=0.8 jets. Unlike the R=0.4 Z+jets default, these jets have enough constituents for soft-drop grooming and N-subjettiness to do real work: compare data/plots/jet_mass.png between the two runs. keep_hepmc is false because the HepMC file for this process is large and is not needed once Delphes has read it.
